doc: The story's chapter select (scripts/screens/chapters.gd, issue #43): the six NASA missions in the order they happened. Each chapter plays its story scenes (data/story/<id>.json: intro, mission, outro); its mission alone is the screen with the same id. Dates and names from each chapter's NASA page (docs/sources.md: S-apollo13-nasa, S-sts61-nasa, S-mpf-nasa, S-lcross-nasa, S-dart-nasa, and Artemis I's). The pictures are NASA images already in the game; DART's is the last full frame of its own camera (S-dart-penultimate).

chapters.name: Apollo 13
chapters.line: Square peg, round hole: build the air filter before the air runs out.
chapters.caption: The real mail box · Apollo 13, 1970

chapters.name: Hubble's first repair
chapters.line: Five spacewalks against the clock to give the telescope its glasses.
chapters.caption: Galaxy M100 after the repair · Hubble, 1993

chapters.name: Mars Pathfinder
chapters.line: Land on Mars by bouncing, then roll Sojourner onto the ground.
chapters.caption: Sojourner on Mars · Pathfinder, 1997

chapters.name: LCROSS
chapters.line: The plan is to crash? Yes. Hit Cabeus and catch the ice.
chapters.caption: The Moon's south pole · LRO

chapters.name: DART
chapters.line: Push an asteroid off its path: the first test of planetary defense.
chapters.caption: DART's camera · Dimorphos 2 s before impact, 2022

chapters.name: Artemis I
chapters.line: The finale: around the Moon and home, with everything you learned.
chapters.caption: The Earth and the Moon · Orion, 2022
